title: Corso recruited to the Army Foreign Technology Division

tellings.quote: Um, Corso stated that in 1960 he was recruited to the US Army's foreign technology division.

plain: In 1960, an Army officer named Philip J. Corso is said to have been recruited to the US Army's foreign technology division, an office for studying other countries' weapons and technology. UAPGerb, an online researcher, tells this to Michels as his own summary of Corso's claim, names Arthur Trudeau in the story, and points to Corso's official military records as backing. It matters because it would place Corso where he could have handled unusual technology.
